stepTitle: What is the speed of a garbage truck that is $$1.20\times10**{4}\,\text{kg}$$ and is initially moving at $$25.0\,\text{m/s}$$ just after it hits and adheres to a trash can that is $$80.0\, \text{kg}$$ and is initially at rest? Give the speed to three significant figures (in $$\text{m/s})$$.
